  - Announce which skill(s) you're using and why (one short line). If you skip an obvious skill, say why.
- Context hygiene:
  - Keep context small: summarize long sections instead of pasting them; only load extra files when needed.

- Safety and fallback: If a skill can't be applied cleanly (missing files, unclear instructions), state the issue, pick the next-best approach, and continue.

## Skills
A skill is a set of local instructions to follow that is stored in a `SKILL.md` file. Below is the list of skills that can be used. Each entry includes a name, description, and file path so you can open the source for full instructions when using a specific skill.
### Available skills
- skill-creator: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Codex's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations. (file: C:/Users/ym199/.codex/skills/.system/skill-creator/SKILL.md)
- skill-installer: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos). (file: C:/Users/ym199/.codex/skills/.system/skill-installer/SKILL.md)
### How to use skills
- Discovery: The list above is the skills available in this session (name + description + file path). Skill bodies live on disk at the listed paths.
- Trigger rules: If the user names a skill (with `$SkillName` or plain text) OR the task clearly matches a skill's description shown above, you must use that skill for that turn. Multiple mentions mean use them all. Do not carry skills across turns unless re-mentioned.

modifier_simple_chase_ai = class({})

function modifier_simple_chase_ai:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_simple_chase_ai:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_simple_chase_ai:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    self.parent = self:GetParent()
    self.attack_range = self.parent:Script_GetAttackRange() + 50
    self.chase_range = 40000
    self.state = "idle"
    self:StartIntervalThink(0.2)
end

function modifier_simple_chase_ai:ResetAI()
    self.state = "idle"
end

function modifier_simple_chase_ai:OnIntervalThink()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local unit = self.parent
    if not unit:IsAlive() then return end

    local target

    local forced_target = unit:GetForceAttackTarget()
    if not forced_target then
        forced_target = nil
    end

    if forced_target then
        target = forced_target
    elseif unit.target_entid then
        target = EntIndexToHScript(unit.target_entid)
        if not target then
            self.state = "idle"
            return
        end
    else
        self.state = "idle"
        return
    end

    if target and not target:IsAlive() then
        target = nil
    end

    if not target then
        self.state = "idle"
        return
    end

    local function GetBoundsRadius(ent)
        if not ent or ent:IsNull() then
            return 0
        end

        if ent.GetHullRadius then
            return ent:GetHullRadius()
        end

        return 0
    end

    local distance = (target:GetAbsOrigin() - unit:GetAbsOrigin()):Length2D()
    distance = math.max(0, distance - GetBoundsRadius(unit) - GetBoundsRadius(target))

    if self.state == "idle" then
        self.state = "chase"

        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = unit:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_TARGET,
            TargetIndex = target:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
        return
    end

    if self.state == "chase" then
        if distance <= self.attack_range then
            self.state = "attack"

            --print("[AI Attack]", target:GetUnitName())

            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = unit:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_ATTACK_TARGET,
                TargetIndex = target:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end

        return
    end

    if self.state == "attack" then
        if distance > self.attack_range + 100 then
            self.state = "chase"

            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = unit:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_TARGET,
                TargetIndex = target:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end

        return
    end
end

function FindNearestPlayer(unit, radius)
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
        unit:GetTeamNumber(),
        unit:GetAbsOrigin(),
        nil,
        radius,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_MAGIC_IMMUNE_ENEMIES,
        FIND_CLOSEST,
        false
    )

    for _, hero in ipairs(enemies) do
        if not hero:HasModifier("modifier_death") then
            return hero
        end
    end

    return nil
end

-- This file contains all barebones-registered events and has already set up the passed-in parameters for you to use.
-- You should comment out or remove the stuff you don't need!

-- Handle stuff when a player disconnects
function barebones:OnDisconnect(keys)
	DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] A Player has disconnected")
	--PrintTable(keys)

	local name = keys.name
	local networkID = keys.networkid
	local reason = keys.reason
	local userID = keys.userid
	local playerID = keys.PlayerID
end

-- The overall game state has changed
function barebones:OnGameRulesStateChange(keys)
	--PrintTable(keys)

	local new_state = GameRules:State_Get()

	if new_state == DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_INIT then
		DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] Game State changed to: DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_INIT")
	elseif new_state == DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_WAIT_FOR_PLAYERS_TO_LOAD then
		DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] Game State changed to: DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_WAIT_FOR_PLAYERS_TO_LOAD")
	elseif new_state == DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_CUSTOM_GAME_SETUP then
		DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] Game State changed to: DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_CUSTOM_GAME_SETUP")
		GameRules:SetCustomGameSetupAutoLaunchDelay(CUSTOM_GAME_SETUP_TIME)
	elseif new_state == DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_HERO_SELECTION then
		DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] Game State changed to: DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_HERO_SELECTION")
		self:PostLoadPrecache()
		self:OnAllPlayersLoaded()
	elseif new_state == DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_STRATEGY_TIME then
		DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] Game State changed to: DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_STRATEGY_TIME")

		-- Force Random a hero for every player that didnt picked or randomed a hero
		-- We do this as a failsafe so players don't end up without a hero
		for playerID = 0, DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS - 1 do
			if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(playerID) and PlayerResource:IsValidPlayer(playerID) then
				-- If this player still hasn't picked a hero, random one
				-- PlayerResource:IsConnected(index) is custom-made! Can be found in 'player_resource.lua' library
				if not PlayerResource:HasSelectedHero(playerID) and PlayerResource:IsConnected(playerID) then
					PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID):MakeRandomHeroSelection() -- this will cause an error if player is disconnected, that's why we check if player is connected
					PlayerResource:SetHasRandomed(playerID)
					PlayerResource:SetCanRepick(playerID, false)
					DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] Randomed a hero for a player number " .. playerID)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif new_state == DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_TEAM_SHOWCASE then
		DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] Game State changed to: DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_TEAM_SHOWCASE")
	elseif new_state == DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_WAIT_FOR_MAP_TO_LOAD then
		DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] Game State changed to: DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_WAIT_FOR_MAP_TO_LOAD")
	elseif new_state == DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_PRE_GAME then
		DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] Game State changed to: DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_PRE_GAME")
		local gamemode = GameRules:GetGameModeEntity()
		gamemode:SetCustomDireScore(0)
		gamemode:SetCustomRadiantScore(0)
	elseif new_state == DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_GAME_IN_PROGRESS then
		DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] Game State changed to: DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_GAME_IN_PROGRESS")
		self:OnGameInProgress()
	elseif new_state == DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_POST_GAME then
		DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] Game State changed to: DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_POST_GAME")
	elseif new_state == DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_DISCONNECT then
		DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] Game State changed to: DOTA_GAMERULES_STATE_DISCONNECT")
	end
end

-- An NPC has spawned somewhere in game. This includes heroes
function barebones:OnNPCSpawned(keys)
	--DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] A unit Spawned")
	--PrintTable(keys)

	local npc
	if keys.entindex then
		npc = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex)
	else
		print("npc_spawned event doesn't have entindex key")
		return
	end

	if npc:IsCourier() and not npc._customized then
		npc._customized = true

		Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
			self:CustomizeCourier(npc)
		end)
	end

	-- Put things here that will happen for every unit or hero when they spawn

	-- OnHeroInGame
	if npc:IsRealHero() and not npc.bFirstSpawned then
		npc.bFirstSpawned = true
		self:OnHeroInGame(npc)
	end
end

function barebones:CustomizeCourier(courier)
	local courier_kv = UnitsKV["npc_custom_courier"]
	print("[CustomizeCourier]")
	if courier_kv then
		local path = courier_kv.Model or ""
		if path ~= "" then
			courier:SetOriginalModel(path)
			courier:SetModel(path)

			courier:ManageModelChanges()

			courier:AddNewModifier(courier, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
			courier:AddNewModifier(courier, nil, "modifier_phased", {}) -- 无碰撞
		end
	end
end

--[[
  Hero spawned for the first time. It can happen if the player's hero is replaced with a new hero for any reason.
  This can be used for initializing heroes, such as adding levels, changing the starting gold, removing/adding abilities, adding physics, etc.
  This happens to bot and custom created heroes as well.
  The hero parameter is the hero entity that just spawned.

]]
function barebones:OnHeroInGame(hero)
	-- Innate abilities like Earth Spirit Stone Remnant (abilities that a hero needs to have auto-leveled up at the start of the game)
	-- Take a look at this guide: https://moddota.com/abilities/creating-innate-abilities
	local innate_abilities = {
		"innate_ability1",
		"innate_ability2"
	}

	-- Cycle through any innate abilities found, then set their level to 1
	for i = 1, #innate_abilities do
		local current_ability = hero:FindAbilityByName(innate_abilities[i])
		if current_ability then
			current_ability:SetLevel(1)
		end
	end

	Timers:CreateTimer(0.5, function()
		local playerID = hero:GetPlayerID() -- never nil (-1 by default), needs delay 1 or more frames

		if PlayerResource:IsFakeClient(playerID) then
			-- This is happening only for bots
			DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnHeroInGame - Bot hero " .. hero:GetUnitName() .. " (re)spawned in the game.")
			-- Set starting gold for bots
			hero:SetGold(NORMAL_START_GOLD, false)
		else
			DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnHeroInGame running for a non-bot player!")
			if not PlayerResource.PlayerData[playerID] and PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(playerID) then
				PlayerResource:InitPlayerDataForID(playerID)
			end
			if hero:IsClone() then

				return
			elseif hero:IsTempestDouble() then

				return

				return

				hero:MakeVisibleToTeam(DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS, 0.5)
				hero:MakeVisibleToTeam(DOTA_TEAM_BADGUYS, 0.5)

				-- Set the starting gold for the player's hero
				-- Use 'PlayerResource:ModifyGold(playerID, NORMAL_START_GOLD-600, false, 0)' if GameRules:SetStartingGold breaks again
				-- If the NORMAL_START_GOLD is less than 600, disable Strategy Time and use 'hero:SetGold(NORMAL_START_GOLD, false)' instead
				-- Why? Because OnHeroInGame is triggering during PreGame (after Strategy Time) and players can buy items during Strategy Time (starting gold will remain default 600)

				if ADDITIONAL_GPM then
					hero:AddNewModifier(hero, nil, "modifier_custom_passive_gold", {})
				end

				-- Create an item and add it to the player's hero, effectively ensuring they start with the item
				if ADD_ITEM_TO_HERO_ON_SPAWN then
					local item = CreateItem("item_example_item", hero, hero)
					hero:AddItem(item)
				end

				-- Make sure that stuff above will not happen again for the player if some other hero spawns
				-- for him for the first time during the game
				PlayerResource.PlayerData[playerID].already_set_hero = true
				DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] OnHeroInGame - Hero " ..
					hero:GetUnitName() .. " set for the player with ID: " .. playerID)
			end
		end
	end)

			local hero_streak = hero:GetStreak()

+

+	self:OnIntervalThink()
+end
+
+function modifier_axe_berserkers_call_persistent:OnRefresh(kv)
+	if not IsServer() then return end
+	self.radius = tonumber(kv.radius) or self.radius
+end

+	if not IsServer() then return end
+	if not self.caster or self.caster:IsNull() then return end

local M = {}

local HANDLER_PATHS = {
    invoker = "projectiles.autocast_specials.invoker",
    phoenix = "projectiles.autocast_specials.phoenix",
}

local handler_cache = {}

function M:GetHandler(key)
    if not key then
        return nil
    end

    if handler_cache[key] then
        return handler_cache[key]
    end

    local path = HANDLER_PATHS[key]
    if not path then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, handler = pcall(require, path)
    if ok and handler then
        handler_cache[key] = handler
        return handler
    end

    return nil
end

return M

modifier_item_cast_listener = class({})

function modifier_item_cast_listener:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_item_cast_listener:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_item_cast_listener:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_item_cast_listener:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_item_cast_listener:DeclareFunctions()
    return {
        MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_ABILITY_FULLY_CAST,
    }
end

function modifier_item_cast_listener:OnCreated(kv)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local itemAbility = self:GetAbility()
    self.ability_name = kv.ability_name
    self.dummy        = EntIndexToHScript(kv.dummy_index)
    self.level        = kv.level or 1
    self.pure_percent = kv.pure_percent or 0
    self.skill_base_damage = kv.skill_base_damage

    -- print("[Cast Listener Create]", self.ability_name, self.dummy:GetUnitName(), self.level)

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        local ab = self.dummy:FindAbilityByName(self.ability_name)
        if not ab then
            ab = self.dummy:AddAbility(self.ability_name)
        end

        if ab then
            ab:SetLevel(self.level)
            ab:SetActivated(true)
        end

        self.mod = self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, itemAbility, "modifier_dummy_cast", {
            ability_name = self.ability_name,
            pure_percent = self.pure_percent,
            skill_base_damage = self.skill_base_damage,
        })
    end
end

function modifier_item_cast_listener:OnAbilityFullyCast(keys)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not keys or not keys.ability then return end

    -- print("[Cast Listener]", keys.ability, self:GetAbility(), self.dummy:GetUnitName(), self.mod:GetName())

    local ab = self:GetAbility()
    if keys.ability ~= ab then
        return
    end

    local target_index = ab.__last_target_index
    local pos = ab.__last_pos

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() and self.mod and not self.mod:IsNull() then
        self.mod:Cast(target_index, pos)
        ab.__last_target_index = nil
        ab.__last_pos = nil
    end
end

function modifier_item_cast_listener:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    print("[Modifier OnDestroy]", self:GetName())

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_cast")
        self.dummy:RemoveAbility(self.ability_name)
        self.dummy = nil
        self.mod = nil
    end
end

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function ParseAbilityCastRange(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local cast_range = ability_kv.AbilityCastRange
    if type(cast_range) == "number" then
        return cast_range
    end
    if type(cast_range) == "string" and cast_range ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(cast_range, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

local function GetCastRange(ability, caster)
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return 0
    end
    if ability.GetCastRange then
        local range = ability:GetCastRange(caster:GetAbsOrigin(), caster)
        if range and range > 0 then
            return range
        end
    end
    return ParseAbilityCastRange(ability:GetAbilityKeyValues())
end

local function BuildTargets(caster, range)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() or range <= 0 then
        return {}
    end
    return FindUnitsInRadius(
        caster:GetTeamNumber(),
        caster:GetAbsOrigin(),
        nil,
        range,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
        FIND_CLOSEST,
        false
    )
end

local PhoenixHandler = {}

function PhoenixHandler:AfterCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= "phoenix_fire_spirits" then
        return false
    end
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    local fire_spirits = profile.skill
    if not fire_spirits or fire_spirits:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    local spirit_count = 0
    if fire_spirits.GetSpecialValueFor then
        spirit_count = fire_spirits:GetSpecialValueFor("spirit_count") or 0
    end
    if spirit_count <= 0 then
        return false
    end

    local launch = EnsureAbility(caster, "phoenix_launch_fire_spirit", fire_spirits:GetLevel())
    if not launch then
        return false
    end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.05, function()
        if caster:IsNull() then
            return
        end
        local range = GetCastRange(launch, caster)
        if range <= 0 then
            return
        end

        local enemies = BuildTargets(caster, range)
        if #enemies == 0 then
            return
        end

        for i = 1, spirit_count do
            local target = enemies[i]
            if not target then
                target = enemies[((i - 1) % #enemies) + 1]
            end
            if target and not target:IsNull() then
                ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                    UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
                    OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                    AbilityIndex = launch:entindex(),
                    Position = target:GetAbsOrigin(),
                    Queue = true,
                })
            end
        end
    end)

    return true
end

return PhoenixHandler

}

    invoker_cold_snap = "quas quas quas",
    invoker_ghost_walk = "quas quas wex",
    invoker_ice_wall = "quas quas exort",
    invoker_emp = "wex wex wex",

}

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function GetInvokerLevels(dummy_level)
    if not dummy_level or dummy_level <= 0 then
        return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[1]
    end
    return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[dummy_level] or INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[#INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS]
end

local function ParseCombo(combo)
    if type(combo) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local counts = { quas = 0, wex = 0, exort = 0 }
    for orb in string.gmatch(combo, "%S+") do
        if counts[orb] ~= nil then
            counts[orb] = counts[orb] + 1
        end
    end
    return counts
end

local function AddToSlots(state, name)
    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
        if slot == name then
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(state.slots, name)
    if #state.slots > 2 then
        table.remove(state.slots, 1)
    end
end

local function EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)
    local levels = GetInvokerLevels(context.dummy_level)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.invoker = context.special_state.invoker or { slots = {} }

    local quas = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_quas", levels.quas or 1)
    local wex = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_wex", levels.wex or 1)
    local exort = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_exort", levels.exort or 1)
    local invoke = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_invoke", 1)

    return quas, wex, exort, invoke
end

function InvokerHandler:Init(context)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)
end

function InvokerHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end

    local combo = ParseCombo(INVOKER_COMBOS[profile.projectile_name])
    if not combo then
        return false
    end

    local quas, wex, exort, invoke = EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)

    if not quas or not wex or not exort then
        return false
    end

    local state = context.special_state and context.special_state.invoker
    if state and state.slots then
        for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
            if slot == profile.projectile_name then
                return false
            end
        end
    end

    local function QueueOrb(orb, count)
        if not orb or count <= 0 then
            return
        end
        for _ = 1, count do
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = context.parent:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = orb:entindex(),
                Queue = true,
            })
        end
    end

    QueueOrb(quas, combo.quas or 0)
    QueueOrb(wex, combo.wex or 0)
    QueueOrb(exort, combo.exort or 0)

    if invoke then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = context.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = invoke:entindex(),
            Queue = true,
        })
    end

    if state then
        AddToSlots(state, profile.projectile_name)
    end

    return true
end

return InvokerHandler

function modifier_death_pulse_listener:IsHidden() return true end

    --print("listener created on:", self:GetParent():GetUnitName())

    if not IsServer() then return end

    --print("modifier_death_pulse_listener:OnAbilityFullyCast(keys)")

    if keys.unit ~= self:GetParent() then return end

    local ability = keys.ability
    if not ability then return end

    if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= "necrolyte_death_pulse" then

    ability._custom_heal = true

    -- 原版死亡脉冲的 AoE 是 500

        FIND_ANY_ORDER,
        false
    )

+	if not IsServer() then return end
+	if not keys or keys.unit ~= self:GetParent() then return end

payload.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/autocast_specials/axe.lua
+local AxeHandler = {}
+
+function AxeHandler:AfterCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
+	if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
+		return false
+	end
+	if not profile or profile.is_attack then
+		return false
+	end
+
+	local ability = profile.skill
+	if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
+		return false
+	end
+	if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= "axe_berserkers_call" then
+		return false
+	end
+
+	local duration = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("duration")
+	local radius = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("radius")
+
+	caster:AddNewModifier(caster, ability, "modifier_axe_berserkers_call_persistent", {
+		duration = duration,
+		radius = radius,
+	})
+
+	return true
+end
+
+return AxeHandler
*** End Patch

**Refactoring taunt periodic handling in axe.lua**

I'm streamlining the taunt functionality by removing the persistent modifier and integrating periodic taunt application directly inside axe.lua using Timers. I'll keep the listener script but simplify it—removing persistent modifier references and its LinkLuaModifier calls from the listener and gamemode files. The new approach schedules a 0.5-second interval after casting to apply and remove taunts cleanly, tracking and clearing previous taunts when casting again. This keeps everything in axe.lua without extra scripts while preserving expected behaviors.

payload.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/autocast_specials/axe.lua
@@
-local AxeHandler = {}
-
-function AxeHandler:AfterCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
-	if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
-		return false
-	end
-	if not profile or profile.is_attack then
-		return false
-	end
-
-	local ability = profile.skill
-	if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
-		return false
-	end
-	if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= "axe_berserkers_call" then
-		return false
-	end
-
-	local duration = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("duration")
-	local radius = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("radius")
-
-	caster:AddNewModifier(caster, ability, "modifier_axe_berserkers_call_persistent", {
-		duration = duration,
-		radius = radius,
-	})
-
-	return true
-end
-
-return AxeHandler
+local AxeHandler = {}
+
+local TAUNT_MODIFIER = "modifier_axe_berserkers_call"
+
+local function RemoveApplied(caster, applied)
+	if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
+		return
+	end
+	if not applied then
+		return
+	end
+
+	for entindex, _ in pairs(applied) do
+		local unit = EntIndexToHScript(entindex)
+		if unit and not unit:IsNull() then
+			unit:RemoveModifierByNameAndCaster(TAUNT_MODIFIER, caster)
+		end
+	end
+end
+
+function AxeHandler:AfterCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
+	if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
+		return false
+	end
+	if not profile or profile.is_attack then
+		return false
+	end
+
+	local ability = profile.skill
+	if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
+		return false
+	end
+	if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= "axe_berserkers_call" then
+		return false
+	end
+
+	local duration = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("duration")
+	local radius = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("radius")
+	if duration <= 0 or radius <= 0 then
+		return false
+	end
+
+	context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
+	context.special_state.axe = context.special_state.axe or {}
+	local state = context.special_state.axe
+
+	state.token = (state.token or 0) + 1
+	state.applied = state.applied or {}
+	RemoveApplied(caster, state.applied)
+	state.applied = {}
+
+	local my_token = state.token
+	local start_time = GameRules:GetGameTime()
+	local end_time = start_time + duration
+
+	Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
+		if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
+			return nil
+		end
+		if not context.special_state or not context.special_state.axe then
+			return nil
+		end
+		if context.special_state.axe.token ~= my_token then
+			return nil
+		end
+
+		local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
+		if now >= end_time then
+			RemoveApplied(caster, state.applied)
+			return nil
+		end
+
+		local remaining = math.max(end_time - now, 0)
+		local taunt_duration = math.min(0.6, remaining)
+
+		local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
+			caster:GetTeamNumber(),
+			caster:GetAbsOrigin(),
+			nil,
+			radius,
+			DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
+			DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
+			DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_MAGIC_IMMUNE_ENEMIES,
+			FIND_ANY_ORDER,
+			false
+		)
+
+		for _, unit in ipairs(enemies) do
+			if unit and not unit:IsNull() and unit:IsAlive() then
+				unit:AddNewModifier(caster, ability, TAUNT_MODIFIER, { duration = taunt_duration })
+				state.applied[unit:entindex()] = true
+			end
+		end
+
+		return 0.5
+	end)
+
+	return true
+end
+
+return AxeHandler
*** End Patch

    local raw = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/shop config/shop1.txt")

            local name         = data.name or ""

                for key, value in pairs(data.price_table) do
                    price_table[tonumber(key)] = tonumber(value)
                end
            end

            self.items[id] = {
                base_price   = base_price,         -- 初始价格
                price_factor = price_factor,       -- 价格倍率
                unlock_time  = now + unlock_delay, -- 解锁时间
                unlock_delay = unlock_delay,
                grade        = grade,              -- 商品等级（装备等级）

            }

        )
    end

    self:SyncToClient()
end

    if self.motion_debug then

local DEBUG_CLONE = false

local function DebugClone(...)
    if DEBUG_CLONE then
        print(...)
    end
end

local function IsUnitBusy(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if unit.IsAttacking and unit:IsAttacking() then
        return true
    end
    if unit.IsChanneling and unit:IsChanneling() then
        return true
    end
    if unit.IsCastingAbility and unit:IsCastingAbility() then
        return true
    end
    if unit.GetCurrentActiveAbility then
        local ab = unit:GetCurrentActiveAbility()
        if ab and not ab:IsNull() then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function HasHigherPriorityReady(self, profile, now)
    if not self or not self.projectiles then
        return false
    end
    local my_interval = profile and profile.interval or 0
    for _, other in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if other ~= profile then
            local other_interval = other.interval or 0
            if other_interval > my_interval then
                local ready = not other.next_cast_time or other.next_cast_time <= now
                if ready then
                    if (not other.is_attack and not other.skill) then
                        ready = false
                    elseif (not other.is_attack and other.skill and not other.skill:IsCooldownReady()) then
                        ready = false
                    elseif other.is_attack or other.behavior == "Target" or other.behavior == "Position" then
                        if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
                            ready = false
                        end
                        if not ready then
                            -- keep ready=false
                        else
                            local origin = self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
                            local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(other.range)
                            local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
                                self.parent:GetTeamNumber(),
                                origin,
                                nil,
                                range,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
                                FIND_ANY_ORDER,
                                false
                            )
                            if #enemies == 0 then
                                ready = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if ready then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local default = {}
local hit_label = "projectile"

local function HasBehavior(behavior, flag)
    return behavior and string.find(behavior, flag, 1, true)
end

local function ResolveCastBehavior(ability_kv)
    local behavior = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""
    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT") then
        return "Position"
    end

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET") then
        local target_team = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityUnitTargetTeam or ""
        if HasBehavior(target_team, "DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_FRIENDLY") then
            return "Self"
        end
        return "Target"
    end

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") then
        return "NoTarget"
    end

    return "NoTarget"
end

local function ParseAbilityCastRange(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local cast_range = ability_kv.AbilityCastRange
    if type(cast_range) == "number" then
        return cast_range
    end
    if type(cast_range) == "string" and cast_range ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(cast_range, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

local function ParseAbilityDuration(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local dur = ability_kv.AbilityDuration
    if type(dur) == "number" then
        return dur
    end
    if type(dur) == "string" and dur ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(dur, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

local function GetAbilityCastRange(profile, pos, owner)
    if not profile or not profile.skill then
        return 0
    end
    local ability = profile.skill
    local range = 0
    if ability.GetCastRange then
        range = ability:GetCastRange(pos or Vector(0, 0, 0), owner or ability:GetCaster())
    end
    if range and range > 0 then
        return range
    end
    return ParseAbilityCastRange(profile.skill_kv or ability:GetAbilityKeyValues())
end

local function ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability)
    if not parent or not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    local ability_kv = ability:GetAbilityKeyValues() or {}
    local behavior = ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_TOGGLE") then
        ability:ToggleAbility()
        return
    end

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_AUTOCAST") then
        if not ability:GetAutoCastState() then
            ability:ToggleAutoCast()
        end
        return
    end

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    end
end

local function GetPlayerStats(owner)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() or (not owner:IsRealHero()) then

    end

    local pid = owner:GetPlayerOwnerID()

    end

    local stats = PlayerStats and PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid) or nil

    end

    return PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid)
end

local AxeHandler = {}

local TAUNT_MODIFIER = "modifier_axe_berserkers_call"

local function RemoveApplied(caster, applied)
	if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
		return
	end
	if not applied then
		return
	end

	for entindex, _ in pairs(applied) do
		local unit = EntIndexToHScript(entindex)
		if unit and not unit:IsNull() then
			unit:RemoveModifierByNameAndCaster(TAUNT_MODIFIER, caster)
		end
	end
end

function AxeHandler:AfterCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
	if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
		return false
	end
	if not profile or profile.is_attack then
		return false
	end

	local ability = profile.skill
	if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
		return false
	end
	if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= "axe_berserkers_call" then
		return false
	end

	print("[AfterCast AXE]")

	local duration = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("duration")
	local radius = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("radius")
	if duration <= 0 or radius <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
	context.special_state.axe = context.special_state.axe or {}
	local state = context.special_state.axe

	state.token = (state.token or 0) + 1
	state.applied = state.applied or {}
	RemoveApplied(caster, state.applied)
	state.applied = {}

	local my_token = state.token
	local start_time = GameRules:GetGameTime()
	local end_time = start_time + duration

	Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
		if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
			return nil
		end
		if not context.special_state or not context.special_state.axe then
			return nil
		end
		if context.special_state.axe.token ~= my_token then
			return nil
		end

		local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
		if now >= end_time then
			RemoveApplied(caster, state.applied)
			return nil
		end

		local remaining = math.max(end_time - now, 0)
		local taunt_duration = math.min(0.6, remaining)

		local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
			caster:GetTeamNumber(),
			caster:GetAbsOrigin(),
			nil,
			radius,
			DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
			DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
			DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_MAGIC_IMMUNE_ENEMIES,
			FIND_ANY_ORDER,
			false
		)

		print("[AfterCast AXE]")

		for _, unit in ipairs(enemies) do
			if unit and not unit:IsNull() and unit:IsAlive() then
				unit:AddNewModifier(caster, ability, TAUNT_MODIFIER, { duration = taunt_duration })
				state.applied[unit:entindex()] = true
			end
		end

		return 0.5
	end)

	return true
end

return AxeHandler

这个信息很关键：  
“合成结果是随机的” + “去掉 invoker_5 饰品仍崩” => **崩溃不是在生成 6 阶结果，而是发生在合成时销毁两个 5 阶 invoker 的流程**。

最可能的点：
- 合成时会 **同时移除两个 5 阶 invoker** → `Shop1Manager:RemoveItem` → `modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnDestroy` → `self.dummy:Destroy()`

下一步我建议这样处理（两种任选其一，都是“行为不变”的安全修复）：
1. **延迟销毁 dummy** 到下一帧：在 `modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnDestroy` 里把 `self.dummy:Destroy()` 改成 `Timers:CreateTimer(0, function() ... end)`，避免同帧双销毁。  
2. **合成时错开删除**：在 `Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate` 里先删一个，另一个用 `Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, ...)` 再删。

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function ParseAbilityCastRange(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local cast_range = ability_kv.AbilityCastRange
    if type(cast_range) == "number" then
        return cast_range
    end
    if type(cast_range) == "string" and cast_range ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(cast_range, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

local function GetCastRange(ability, caster)
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return 0
    end
    if ability.GetCastRange then
        local range = ability:GetCastRange(caster:GetAbsOrigin(), caster)
        if range and range > 0 then
            return range
        end
    end
    return ParseAbilityCastRange(ability:GetAbilityKeyValues())
end

local function BuildTargets(caster, range)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() or range <= 0 then
        return {}
    end
    return FindUnitsInRadius(
        caster:GetTeamNumber(),
        caster:GetAbsOrigin(),
        nil,
        range,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
        FIND_CLOSEST,
        false
    )
end

local PhoenixHandler = {}

local ROOTED_MODIFIER = "modifier_rooted"

local function EnsureState(context)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.phoenix = context.special_state.phoenix or {}
    return context.special_state.phoenix
end

local function SaveOrigin(state, caster)
    local pos = caster:GetAbsOrigin()
    state.icarus_origin = Vector(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
end

function PhoenixHandler:AfterCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= "phoenix_fire_spirits" then
        return false
    end
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    local fire_spirits = profile.skill
    if not fire_spirits or fire_spirits:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    local spirit_count = 0
    if fire_spirits.GetSpecialValueFor then
        spirit_count = fire_spirits:GetSpecialValueFor("spirit_count") or 0
    end
    if spirit_count <= 0 then
        return false
    end

    local launch = EnsureAbility(caster, "phoenix_launch_fire_spirit", fire_spirits:GetLevel())
    if not launch then
        return false
    end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.05, function()
        if caster:IsNull() then
            return
        end
        local range = GetCastRange(launch, caster)
        if range <= 0 then
            return
        end

        local enemies = BuildTargets(caster, range)
        if #enemies == 0 then
            return
        end

        for i = 1, spirit_count do
            local target = enemies[i]
            if not target then
                target = enemies[((i - 1) % #enemies) + 1]
            end
            if target and not target:IsNull() then
                ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                    UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
                    OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                    AbilityIndex = launch:entindex(),
                    Position = target:GetAbsOrigin(),
                    Queue = true,
                })
            end
        end
    end)

    return true
end

function PhoenixHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    if not context or not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= "phoenix_icarus_dive" then
        return false
    end
    if not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    local state = EnsureState(context)
    state.icarus_token = (state.icarus_token or 0) + 1
    SaveOrigin(state, context.parent)

    if context.parent:HasModifier(ROOTED_MODIFIER) then
        context.parent:RemoveModifierByName(ROOTED_MODIFIER)
    end

    return true
end

function PhoenixHandler:AfterCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end

    if profile.projectile_name ~= "phoenix_icarus_dive" then
        return false
    end
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    local ability = profile.skill
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    local state = EnsureState(context)
    local token = state.icarus_token
    local origin = state.icarus_origin
    if not origin then
        return false
    end

    local duration = 0
    if ability.GetSpecialValueFor then
        duration = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("dive_duration") or 0
    end
    if duration <= 0 then
        duration = 2.0
    end

    Timers:CreateTimer(duration, function()
        if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
            return nil
        end
        local current = context.special_state and context.special_state.phoenix
        if not current or current.icarus_token ~= token then
            return nil
        end

        FindClearSpaceForUnit(caster, origin, true)
        caster:AddNewModifier(caster, nil, ROOTED_MODIFIER, {})
        return nil
    end)

    return true
end

return PhoenixHandler
